column1: # BW-ORG: the vault reorganisation reviewer. Format: see the header of ~/.config/hub/hub.

column9: fzf-menu list of the plan written by `vault-audit plan`: every item with its folder, its target and which of td / yc will see it. f folder, n keep, d duplicate of, D trash the group, u undo, r reset, t filter, e edit the whole plan, s summary, R rename a folder, Enter reviewed. Nothing is changed in the vault until `vault-audit apply`.

column3: Vault sharing (scopes of td and yc)
column6: ghostty --class=float.tui --title=vault-share -e bash -c 'vault-share status; echo; vault-share report; echo; read -n1 -p "press a key "'
column9: Owner view of the broker that serves td and yc their part of the vault: the unit and socket, the scope file, and how many items each user can read right now (counts only; vault-share report --names lists them). Values are served only while rbw is unlocked.
